encyclopedia.summary: Firaxis Games' 2010 turn-based strategy game and the fifth main entry in the Civilization series. You pick a civilisation, build cities from prehistory into the modern age and chase victory through science, diplomacy or war. The expansions Gods & Kings and Brave New World added religion, trade and a culture victory.
highlights: Hex tiles and one unit per tile changed combat for the series.
City-states and religion became the axis of diplomacy.
Mod support has lasted, so map and civilisation packs keep appearing.
